card.text: M34 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 490 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_1039: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 489.73176952 pc (16th to 84th percentile 489 to 490)

sources.quote: Messier 34 is a large and relatively near open cluster in Perseus.

introduction.text: M34 is drawn as 589 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
